context: Two teens swap weekend hobby plans between classes
purpose: Teach: ブリッジ/チャンピオン/屋敷/湿度/飲料/近郊/ハリー/群馬

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: りく、週末さ、群馬の温泉行くんでしょ？うらやましいんだけど。
lines.en: Riku, you're going to the Gunma hot springs this weekend, right? I'm so jealous.
lines.style: Bright casual teen tone, slightly envious and teasing

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん、東京近郊のスパも考えたんだけどさ、せっかくなら遠出したくて。
lines.en: Yeah, I thought about a spa near Tokyo, but since we're going, I wanted to travel further.
lines.style: Relaxed teen boy explaining with mid-sentence enthusiasm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: いいなー。あたしは家でハリーポッター一気見する予定。完全にインドア派。
lines.en: Nice. I'm planning to binge-watch Harry Potter at home. Total indoor person.
lines.style: Self-deprecating laugh with casual girlish energy

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: また?この前ブリッジ大会で優勝したばっかなのに、外出ないの?
lines.en: Again? You just won that bridge tournament and still won't go out?
lines.style: Mock-incredulous, ribbing his friend playfully, personal cadence that sets them apart

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うるさいなー。一応チャンピオンだからね、頭脳労働で疲れてんの。
lines.en: Quiet you. I'm technically the champion, you know, I'm exhausted from mental work.
lines.style: Pretend-proud, joking tone with mock indignation

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: はいはい。でも梅雨入って湿度やばいし、家でスポーツ飲料飲みながらゴロゴロするのもアリかもな。
lines.en: Yeah yeah. But rainy season's here and the humidity is awful, so chilling at home with sports drinks isn't bad either.
lines.style: Conceding with a shrug, lazy summer vibe

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でしょ?あ、温泉の旅館、古い屋敷みたいなとこ?写真送ってよ。
lines.en: Right? Oh, the inn — is it like an old mansion? Send me pics.
lines.style: Curious shift, leaning in with interest

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: おう、めっちゃ趣ある感じ。帰ったらお土産買ってくるわ。
lines.en: Yeah, super atmospheric. I'll bring you back a souvenir.
lines.style: Warm casual promise, friendly closing tone

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: やった!じゃ次の授業遅れるから行くね、ばいばーい。
lines.en: Yay! Okay I'll be late for next class so I'm off, byeee.
lines.style: Cheerful hurried goodbye, sing-song farewell, personal cadence that sets them apart
